digest.component_or_area: S2 CLI parser and route registry
propositions: Define a narrow factory protocol for parser construction that accepts only prog parameter and returns argparse.ArgumentParser without importing handlers or optional dependencies.

Implement immutable route records holding lazy handler and parser-factory references plus metadata for identity, alias, visibility, help, mount, confirmation, and capability without resolving handlers at construction time.

Validate route registry for duplicate spellings, illegal alias/retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capabilities, and malformed references deterministically without cutting over existing help or execution paths.
Derive legacy policy-set exports from routes and confirm parity with current command sets without breaking existing help files or execution behavior.
Provide deterministic argparse customization producing fixed-width help output, UTF-8 LF formatting with trailing newline, and compatibility-shaped parse errors regardless of terminal.
